design_principle.weight_derivation: Equal absolute re-normalization across the five surviving v2.1E conceptual factors; no empirical candidate results were available or used.

proposed_slots.release_rule: Monday 16:15 America/New_York for the previous business week's daily index observations; holiday Monday shifts to the next business day.
proposed_slots.historical_vintage_rule: Use only values contained in an H.10 release available by the Friday cutoff; bind the exact release provenance.

proposed_slots.release_rule: Use only the PPI value published in a BLS release available by the Friday cutoff; BLS PPI releases are scheduled at 08:30 America/New_York.
proposed_slots.revision_rule: PPI values remain subject to revision for four months after originally scheduled publication; point-in-time research must bind the vintage actually available at each Friday cutoff.
proposed_slots.historical_vintage_rule: Archived BLS PPI release evidence is mandatory; current revised history is not an allowed historical-vintage substitute.

proposed_slots.product: H.8 Assets and Liabilities of Commercial Banks in the United States
proposed_slots.series_label: Bank credit, all commercial banks, seasonally adjusted
proposed_slots.release_rule: Friday generally 16:15 America/New_York; federal-holiday Friday shifts to Thursday. Use only values contained in the release available by cutoff.
proposed_slots.historical_vintage_rule: Release-vintage snapshot is mandatory; latest revised history is not an allowed historical-vintage substitute.

proposed_slots.release_rule: Thursday generally 16:30 America/New_York; use Wednesday level only after release.
proposed_slots.historical_vintage_rule: Bind the exact H.4.1 release provenance; later corrections may not silently replace the historically available value.

proposed_slots.release_rule: Thursday generally 16:30 America/New_York; use Wednesday level only after release.
proposed_slots.historical_vintage_rule: Bind the exact H.4.1 release provenance; later corrections may not silently replace the historically available value.

candidate_scale.regime_band_scale_intent: Preserve the v2.1E weighted-z-score scale by keeping absolute weights normalized to 1.0; exact bands must be frozen in preregistration before any v2.1F real-data results.

mandatory_preregistration_topics: BLS WPU0561 historical vintage reconstruction strategy
redundancy diagnostics for the five-slot factor set
historical anchor windows and acceptance thresholds fixed before results
known_research_risks: Removing the three H.15 factors materially changes the economic factor mix and eliminates direct nominal/real-rate channels.
BLS WPU0561 is monthly and slower than market WTI, changing the energy channel.
BLS PPI observations are revised for four months, so point-in-time vintage reconstruction is mandatory.
H.8 is revised and subject to benchmark changes/reclassifications.
Primary credit can be near zero for long periods and may miss stress expressed through special facilities.
H.4.1 total assets and primary credit may become correlated in crises.
Five equal-absolute-weight factors may increase the influence of sparse or slow-moving series relative to v2.1E.
H.10 broad-dollar data are normally one business week behind the Friday cutoff because the week's observations are released the following Monday.
